open_errors.issue: Ch 2 says Neela catches his wrist 'the way she did at the kalari when she was about to correct his guard', which makes kalari visits a habit. Ch 5 states the pit was 'a place she had been in once before, at dawn' (book 1, ch 11).
open_errors.fix: Make the ch 2 reference point to the single dawn at the kalari.

patches.find: She caught his wrist as she passed, quick, the way she did at the kalari when she was about to correct his guard, and the bracelets of scar on her skin pressed hot against the pulse in his.
patches.replace: She caught his wrist as she passed, quick, the way she had at the kalari the dawn she corrected his guard, and the bracelets of scar on her skin pressed hot against the pulse in his.

open_errors.issue: Devan scrapes the pit wall and the wound-share opens a welt 'across the back of her right knuckle'. His own blood is then placed 'on the heel of his right hand', so the shared wound sits in two different places.
open_errors.fix: Put Devan's scrape on the back of his right knuckle to match hers.

patches.find: There was a smear of blood on the heel of his right hand and he looked at it as if it belonged to someone else.
patches.replace: There was a smear of blood across the back of his right knuckle and he looked at it as if it belonged to someone else.

open_errors.issue: Neela returns in leopard shape and turns back on the ledge at dawn, yet she 'came up the ledge ... with her cloth round her shoulders'. She has no cloth until Devan gives her one, and the cache is empty.
open_errors.fix: Have her turn back on the sill, then Devan puts the cloth on her.

patches.find: She came up the ledge at the grey of dawn with her cloth round her shoulders and her knees shaking.
patches.replace: She came up the ledge at the grey of dawn and turned back on the sill, knees shaking, and he put her cloth round her shoulders.

open_errors.issue: Devan left Neela 'sleeping in the hall above' when he went to the dawn pit. She sleeps in the warden's chamber; the hall is the public room with eight pillars.

patches.find: A bruise broke no skin, so the woman he had left sleeping in the hall above would feel none of it.
patches.replace: A bruise broke no skin, so the woman he had left sleeping in the chamber above would feel none of it.

open_errors.issue: Ch 32 has Devan say 'Rema handed it back' about the green-stitched quire, and continuity (F656, F711) records Rema refusing to break the queen's seal. No chapter shows that handback. The ch 30 south-range scene with Rema never mentions the quire, so the ch 32 line refers to an event that is not on the page.
open_errors.fix: Add one beat to the ch 30 south-range scene in which Rema declines the quire.

patches.find: Rema went to the door and stopped with her hand on the bar.
patches.replace: Devan laid the green-stitched quire on the table. Rema looked at the queen's wax, said a seal the queen laid on was not hers to break, and pushed it back to him. Then she went to the door and stopped with her hand on the bar.
